about: Pinned replays for the native-vs-wasm parity check. Expected values were recorded natively; engine-wasm/tests/parity.rs (native) and scripts/check-parity.mjs (web/pkg) re-simulate every file and compare.

fixtures.why: Chaser vs Wanderer on MatchConfig::duel at seed u64::MAX (18446744073709551615): the largest seed, not representable as a JS number, so it must survive as a decimal string in both engines; ends last_standing.
Chaser vs Wanderer, seed 2916: both tanks die on the same tick, so the match ends as an all_destroyed draw (winner null).

Per-tank params (replay format 4): the documented withConfig example, Glass Cannon 28 dmg / 60 HP vs Brawler 24 dmg, 90 u/s, 273 BAU/tick, 120 HP, seed 42 (docs/engine/wasm-and-web.md, determinism.md).
projectile_spread_still = Some(0) (format 4): a still tank's shot draws no RNG, so the RNG stream depends on movement. Seed 28 ends at tick 263 instead of 305 without it.

Tank Arena rules v1 as WasmMatch.tank plays it: seed=2&blue=charger-5-3-1&orange=charger-5-3-1. Loadouts as per-tank params, fixed spawns, the pillar arena; ends last_standing (orange) at tick 816, the winner on 54 HP.

Tank Arena: seed=0&blue=sniper-5-3-1&orange=charger-5-3-1. The sniper holds a spot with a sight line and fires only when it sees the target, so its shots depend on the pillars; ends last_standing (blue, the sniper) at tick 1023.

Tank Arena 2v2 corner spawns (four tanks, teammates, no friendly fire), charger/kiter/sniper/charger with loadouts 5-3-1, 2-5-2, 3-1-5, 4-4-1, seed 1, max_ticks cut to 360 so it ends at the tick_limit (a draw) while small. Two tanks (both chargers) have taken hits by then.
